'''HoDoMS''' (Heads of Departments of Mathematical Sciences) is an educational company that acts as a body to represent the heads of [[United Kingdom]] [[higher education]] departments of [[mathematical sciences]]. It aims to discuss and promote the interests of higher education mathematics in the UK and to facilitate dialogue between departments.<ref name="JMCmembers">{{cite web |title=Our Members |url=https://www.jmc.org.uk/our-members/ |publisher=The Joint Mathematical Council of the United Kingdom |access-date=10 August 2021}}</ref>

==Governance==

HoDoMS is operated by a committee including four officer roles which are listed below with incumbents.<ref name="HoDoMS-about">{{cite web |title=About Us |url=https://www.hodoms.org.uk/About_Us.html |publisher=HoDoMS |access-date=10 August 2021}}</ref> The committee includes observers from the [[Institute of Mathematics and its Applications]], [[Operational Research Society|The OR Society]], the [[Royal Statistical Society]], the [[Council for the Mathematical Sciences]] and the [[Edinburgh Mathematical Society]].<ref name="HoDoMS-about"/><ref>{{cite book |title=Annual Report to Members 2020 |date=2020 |publisher=Institute of Mathematics & its Applications |page=12 |url=https://cdn.ima.org.uk/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Annual-Report-to-Members-2020-pdf.pdf |access-date=10 August 2021}}</ref>

==Activities==
The main activity of HoDoMS is to run an annual conference bringing members together for briefings and discussion on current issues.<ref name="HoDoMS-website">{{cite web |title=HoDoMS Heads of Department of Mathematical Sciences |url=https://www.hodoms.org.uk/ |publisher=HoDoMS |access-date=10 August 2021}}</ref><ref name="HoDoMS-conference">{{cite web |title=Annual Conference and AGM |url=https://www.hodoms.org.uk/AGM.html |publisher=HoDoMS |access-date=10 August 2021}}</ref> For example, the 2020 conference heard briefings on policy issues such as research funding, the [[Research Excellence Framework|Research Excellence Framework 2021]], the [[Teaching Excellence Framework]] as well as practicalities such as online marking, knowledge exchange, teaching as a career for mathematics undergraduates, and academics and mental health.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Burbanks |first1=Andrew |title=Heads of Department of Mathematical Sciences Annual Conference |url=https://researchportal.port.ac.uk/portal/en/activities/hodoms-annual-conference(471dbdd8-78bc-446e-8e29-4f9f3681f6c1).html |website=Portsmouth Research Portal |publisher=University of Portsmouth |access-date=10 August 2021}}</ref>

HoDoMS also collaborates with other organisations, for example with the [[London Mathematical Society]] on an 'Education Day' in 2019<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Hobbs |first1=Cathy |title=Report: LMS Education Day 2019 |journal=LMS Newsletter |date=July 2019 |issue=483 |page=16 |url=https://www.lms.ac.uk/sites/default/files/NLMS_483_for_web.pdf |access-date=10 August 2021}}</ref> and with the [[Institute of Mathematics and its Applications]] and the [[Isaac Newton Institute]] on an 'Induction Course for New Lecturers in the Mathematical Sciences' in 2021<ref>{{cite web |title=Induction Course for New Lecturers in the Mathematical Sciences 2021 |url=https://ima.org.uk/13572/induction-course-for-new-lecturers-in-the-mathematical-sciences-2021/ |publisher=Institute of Mathematics and its Applications |access-date=10 August 2021}}</ref>

==History==
The first meeting of HoDoMS took place on 14 September 1995 at [[University College, London]] under its first chair, [[Graham Wilks]].<ref name="HoDoMS-about"/> On 14 August 2018, HoDoMS was incorporated as a [[Private company limited by guarantee]].<ref>{{cite web |title=HEADS OF DEPARTMENTS OF MATHEMATICAL SCIENCES |url=https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/11516322 |website=Companies House |access-date=10 August 2021}}</ref>

==Affiliations==
HoDoMS is a member of the [[Joint Mathematical Council|Joint Mathematical Council of the United Kingdom (JMC)]].<ref name="JMCmembers"/>
